XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Immobiliser warning light comes on and occasional starting failures
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INIEZIONE | ELETTRONICA | ANTENNA | IMMOBILIZER | U1600 | ACCENDE | ACCESA | SIMBOLO | LUCCHETTO | GIALLO | GIALLA | AVVIA | PARTE | ACCENDE | MANCATA | ACCENSIONE | MANCATO | AVVIAMENTO | FUNZIONA | FUNZIONAMENTO | AVVIO |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Immobiliser antenna

  • Fault: Immobiliser fault warning light illuminated with occasional engine starting failures. Occasionally, the warning light goes out and the engine starts normally.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: U1600 (Key coding fault)

  • Cause: Faulty immobiliser antenna

• Action: Check that the immobiliser antenna is working correctly and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is a ‘ring’ fitted to the key cylinder; once replaced, the problem was permanently resolved.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 0.4 h.
